component.name: Tenshi (Flatpak Test)
component.summary: Test read-only disk analysis and file recovery in a Flatpak sandbox

description.p: This experimental package tests Tenshi in a Flatpak sandbox. Browse supported filesystems in disk images, export files to a separate drive and create disk images.
Sources are opened read-only. Recovery is not guaranteed. Physical devices require separately configured read permissions. This package is not a stable release.
